name: Buttermilk
description: A refreshing jug of buttermilk. With its lightly sour flavor and silky texture, it’s very refreshing.

name: Chamomile Tea
description: A very healthy beverage that helps the body recover and prepare for the day to come.

name: Cooked Fae Deer Milk
description: A delicious jug of Fae Deer milk. Drinking it will grant you endurance and recharge your stamina faster!

name: Frizzy Goat Milk
description: A delicious jug of Frizzy Goat milk. Drinking it will grant you endurance.

name: Glimmer Gentian Tea
description: This is an herbal tea with added glimmer gentian. The Blossoms create a smooth texture and extend your Time in the shroud.

name: Herbal Mountain Tea
description: A strong, herbal tea. It increases your mana and stamina.

name: Milk
description: A delicious jug of milk. Drinking it will grant you endurance and recharge your stamina faster!

name: Rooibos Tea
description: An aromatic ingredient that calms the body, providing an instant boost of Stamina for the user.

name: Spiced Tea
description: Hot and spicy! The best drink for heated areas, refreshing and cooling the body at the same time.

name: Strawberry Milkshake
description: A delightful milkshake. Be careful with the sugar rush! It will recharge your endurance and stamina more quickly.

name: Uncooked Fae Deer Milk
description: Raw Fae Deer Milk. It has to be cooked to be consumed safely.

name: Water Pouch
description: This pouch can be filled at a well or lake. A sip of water helps recharge your power!

name: Aureolin Flower
description: A beautiful yellow flower with magical properties that increases the user's mana.

name: Azure Russula
description: The Azure Russula — an ancient mushroom, existing and consuming magic since the beginning of time. Unfortunately inedible if not cooked.

name: Beef Stew
description: A burning hot, meaty stew. Increases your resistance against extreme cold and improves your health and health regeneration.

name: Bell Pepper
description: A crisp, vibrant red bell pepper with a sweet, juicy flavor and a glossy skin.

name: Boiled Eggs
description: Simple but nourishing. Boosts regeneration in all areas.

name: Butter
description: Creamy butter with milky richness-perfect for bringing depth and tenderness to your baked creations.

name: Calla Luna Soup
description: A soup made from various vegetables and calla luna flowers. It glows in the dark and extends your time in the Shroud!

name: Chanterelle
description: It tastes incredibly bitter when raw, but develops a zesty aroma while cooked.

name: Chicken Soup
description: A very healthy soup made by boiling chicken for a period of time. An old house maiden's dish to help protect the body from illness

name: Corncob
description: A very versatile crop that can be dried, grilled or consumed raw, strengthening the consumer for a short duration.

name: Dried Purple Berry
description: When conserved, the Dried Purple Berry do not regenerate as much Health as the Purple berries. However, the duration lasts longer.

name: Ectoplasm Soup
description: Unnerving goo. It bestows great powers on those who eat it.

name: Eggs
description: A great source of protein that enhances the muscle mass. Best consumed before a good exercise.

name: Excellent Ectoplasm Soup
description: Even the most carefully cooked Ectoplasm Soup still tastes a little bit...fermented.

name: Flat Bread
description: A simple meal, granting a lasting Melee Damage boost upon consumption. It tastes better in combination with other things, though.

name: Forest Beet
description: The edible root of a forest plant. Not all that sustaining on its own. Maybe good as an ingredient?

name: Fruit Bowl
description: A refreshing bowl of fruits with positive health benefits.

name: Gloomberry
description: A special berry that can only be harvested at night in the Revelwood. It can be used to enhance various dishes and to create deep blue pigments.

name: Glow Soup
description: A weird brew emitting a blue glow...Nobody quite knows why.

name: Grapple Plant
description: A resilient herb, growing in the harsh Kindlewastes climate. Spiritualists were known to use it for mystical purposes.

name: Greater Ectoplasm Soup
description: This slimy soup was improved with some salt, slow-cooked broth, and the added aroma of fearing death.

name: Grilled Bird Meat
description: A healthy protein rich snack. The color looks just perfect..

name: Grilled Dune Armadillo
description: A specialty of the Kindlewastes - customers love it because of its health benefits!

name: Grilled Fatty Meat
description: Beautifully tender, juicy meat. It fills the belly and warms the soul by providing better frost resistance!

name: Grilled Game
description: A staple in many traditional Revelwood dishes. It has a rejuvenating effect.

name: Grilled Lean Meat
description: Rich in protein and delicious, but only a small snack. Increases the Constitution of the user by a small margin.

name: Grilled Penny Bun
description: A smoky grilled mushroom that temporarily amplifies your magical power when eaten.

name: Grilled Wolf Meat
description: Roasted ribs were a delicacy back in the day, granting a good amount of Constitution to the consumer.

name: Grilled Yucca Fruit
description: When cooked, the Yucca Fruit becomes very sweet. Makes the mouth water and recovers Stamina.

name: Hazelnut
description: A nice snack for the way. The strength it takes to crack its shell, it gives back upon consumption.

name: Honey
description: The following sugar rush recharges stamina!

name: Meat and Corncob Skewer
description: With just some meat, a corncob, and a small fire, you can make this nutritious skewer anywhere and at any time.

name: Meat and Mushroom Skewer
description: It's a simple combination — a mushroom and some meat on a skewer — but the flavor and the effects go a long way.

name: Meat and Tomato Skewer
description: Even in the simplest setting, this skewer comes together easily with meat, a tomato, and a small flame.

name: Meat Wrap
description: Filled with the power of life, this wrap will increase the Health of the consumer.

name: Midnight Lily
description: An edible flower used to enhance the effect of certain dishes. It only blooms at night in the Springlands.

name: Mushroom Omelette
description: A delicious meal with an earthly taste.

name: Open Sandwich
description: A relatively simple, but strengthening meal. Fast and ready to go!

name: Penny Bun
description:
A great snack that stimulates the brain.
Increases your intelligence by a small amount.

name: Popcorn
description: Greatly regenerates Stamina upon consumption. Delightful and sweet.

name: Pumpkin
description: Everyone unanimously agees that it is the spookiest vegetable of them all.

name: Pumpkin Soup
description: A tasty pumpkin soup. It's creamy and rich in flavor. It will also keep you warm. What’s not to love?

name: Purple Berries
description: Tasty and fresh berries, stimulating the bodily regeneration abilities with fresh vitamins for a short duration.

name: Purple Berry Cake
description: The sugar rush powers your stamina regeneration for a short amount of time.

name: Raw Bird Meat
description: It's not properly cooked. Eating this raw would cause nausea.

name: Raw Dune Armadillo Meat
description: Fleshy and tough. Better not eat it like this.

name: Raw Fatty Meat
description: A tender, raw slab of fatty meat. It is uncooked, and therefore not consumable.

name: Raw Game
description: Uncooked game. Must be roasted over a fire.

name: Raw Lean Meat
description: Inedible, raw meat. Must be cooked over a campfire.

name: Raw Wolf Meat
description: Raw Wolf meat. Must be cooked for proper consumption.

name: Roasted Azure Russula
description: Watery and a little strange, this mushroom's odd taste comes from pure magic coursing throughout. Great power awaits the consumer.

name: Roasted Corncob
description: Roasted with a smoky aroma, it's a real pleasure for the taste buds, able to set free all of its strengthening attributes.

name: Sage Leaves
description: A bitter tasting herb that can be found in dry areas. It's said to have enlightening abilities.

name: Shadowbloom Wrap
description: This wrap is a good alternative to the more commonly seen meat wrap. It still increases your health, and additionally, the shadowbloom stocks are very filling and extend your time in the Shroud.

name: Shortcrust Pastry Base
description: Perfectly crisp and buttery- a golden foundation for your sweetest baking experiments.

name: Shroud Meteor Shower
description: This scroll is enchanted with the power of the Shroud Meteor Shower. It releases a giant shower of Shroud Meteors on enemies around the caster. But be careful, it drains your remaining time in the Shroud upon usage.

name: Stinging Nettle
description: One has to be careful when harvesting this herb, but the reward is surely worth it.

name: Stir-Fried Vegetables
description: A healthy mix of vegetables. If handled with care, it won't only fill the stomach.

name: Strawberry
description: A delicious aggregate-accessory fruit, predominantly found in the Revelwood.

name: Strawberry Cake
description: The sugar rush powers your stamina regeneration for a short amount of time.

name: Sugar
description: The sugar rush powers your stamina regeneration for a short amount of time.

name: Sugar Cane
description: A sweet candy alternative made from plant fiber. The sugar rush is known to regenerate energy for a short amount of time.

name: Tomato
description: A red and juicy Tomato! If handled with care, it can have Dexterity enhancing effects.

name: Vegetable Puree
description: Cooking is a delicate art form. This basic puree will aid any person on their way to becoming an exquisite chef.

name: Vegetable Soup
description: A warm soup made from various vegetables. Full of vitamins and energy.

name: Wolfsbane
description: This plant is notable due to its stunning electrifying colorway, its delicate petals, and its deadly poison.

name: Yellow Glow Soup
description: It tastes a bit bitter, but is known to increase mana, mana regeneration and magic damage. What a magical soup!

name: Yucca Fruit
description: A sweet fruit that grows in dry areas, needing little water. Despite that, it's quite refresing.

name: Antidote
description: An antidote that instantly cures any poison effect.

name: Bandage
description: This item heals 40% health over 10 seconds if applied to a wound. Receiving any damage interrupts the healing effect.

name: Cleaned Bandage
description: Restores 60% of health over 10 seconds. Stops when damage is received.

name: Diver's Endurance Flask
description: A flask brewed from rare underwater materials, easing the strain of every powerful stroke.

name: Drak Soulward Flask
description: A dark concoction distilled from enemy remains. It unveils the writings of their kin and sharpens your blade against them.

name: Elixir
description: This Elixir of the Shroud contains great power.... at a cost.

name: Experience Scroll
description: The most different experiences gathered and described on a scroll. Gain a small amount of experience based upon absorption of the content.

name: Fell Curse Cleansing Tonic
description:
Removes Fell Curse upon use.

Also applies a buff that prevents the curse from affecting the user for an hour.

name: Fire Wisp Summon
description: The scroll summons a Fire Wisp that follows, assists you in battle and provides light.

name: Flask of the Fell
description: The Shroud grants power to not only the Fell, but to whoever drinks from this flask.

name: Greater Antidote
description: An improved antidote that will cure poison and negate the next poisoning.

name: Greater Health Potion
description: After finetuning the Health Potion, the ingredients were adjusted, instantly restoring a great amount of health upon consumption.

name: Greater Health Potion +
description: Instantly restores a medium amount of health, and continuosly heals for 10 seconds.

name: Greater Mana Potion
description: A mana potion with higher concentration, instantly restoring a great amount of mana upon use.

name: Greater Mana Potion +
description: Instantly restores a medium amount of mana, and continuously replenishes it for 10 seconds.

name: Greater Shroud Survival Flask
description:
Contains cleansed Shroud Liquid, enhancing the resistance of the user.
Extends the Maximum time in the shroud after consumption by 4 Minutes. This effect will last for 45 Minutes.

name: Health Potion
description: Filled with vitalizing ingredients, it instantly restores a good amount of health.

name: Health Potion +
description: Instantly restores a small amount of health, and continuously heals for 10 seconds.

name: Hemotoxin Antidote
description:
Removes Hemotoxin debuff upon use.

Also applies a buff that prevents the hemotoxin from affecting the user for an hour.

name: Ice Protection Lotion
description: A lotion that protects you from the cold seeping in. It grants its user +1 ice armor per level.

name: Improved Bandage
description: A bandage that was made more absorbent by moss. The added silver dust and wound ointment prevent infection.

name: Mana Potion
description: Created with mana-potent ingredients, the Mana Potion restores a good amount of mana.

name: Mana Potion +
description: Instantly restores a small amount of mana, and continuously replenishes it for 10 seconds.

name: Pocket Heater
description: After ignition the leather limits the amount of air around the coal, causing it to burn slower. This will keep you warm for a bit.

name: Prayer of the Flame Scroll
description: Offers a small prayer to the Flame, that increases your magic damage and the maximum time in the Shroud for a short duration.

name: Revitalizing Health Potion
description: The pinnacle of potioncraft. It gained its name after rescuing users from countless near-death situations. Instantly restores an unbelievable amount of health.

name: Revitalizing Health Potion +
description: Instantly restores a lot of health, and continuosly heals for 10 seconds.

name: Sacred Vukah Scroll
description: Offers a prayer to the ancient Vukah. If answered, the user receives a buff in stamina and strength.

name: Shroud Survival Flask
description: Contains cleansed Shroud Liquid, enhancing the resistance of the user. Extends the remaining time in the Shroud after consumption by 2 minutes. This effect will last for 45 minutes.

name: Superior Health Potion
description: It's a truly inspired concotion, and vastly superior to all other currently known Health Potions.

name: Superior Health Potion +
description: Instantly restores health massively, and continuosly heals for 10 seconds.

name: Superior Mana Potion
description: A precisely formulated mana potion that instantly restores a massive amount of mana upon use.

name: Superior Mana Potion +
description: Instantly restores a large amount of mana, and continuously replenishes it for 10 seconds.

name: Ultimate Health Potion
description: Hard to believe there is an even better concoction.

name: Ultimate Health Potion +
description: Instantly restores health massively, and continuously heals for 10 seconds.

name: Ultimate Mana Potion
description: An excellently formulated mana potion that instantly restores a massive amount of mana upon use.

name: Ultimate Mana Potion +
description: Instantly restores a large amount of mana, and continuously replenishes it for 10 seconds.

name: Wisp of Light
description: An imprisoned Wisp of Light. Opening the flask releases a glowing wisp that lights the darkness.
